## Selected Projects

- [Duel-Masters](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/1354115610): Modern digital recreation of the Duel Masters trading card game: Godot 4 C# client with pure-C# data-driven architecture.
- [tarek-portfolio-backend](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/1135234827): ASP.NET Core backend for this portfolio: contact API with validation, rate limiting and email delivery.
- [ThreeDMarket](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/508857959): Full-stack 3D asset marketplace: Angular + three.js frontend with a Spring Boot backend.
- [DungeonWorldApp](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/1325975559): Full-stack web app that turns Fighting Fantasy-style gamebook PDFs into playable adventures.
- [chkoba](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/1106587367): 2D card game built with the Godot engine.
- [Project-Structure](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/1351002529): Starter Godot project-structure template for C# users with a clean architecture.
- [StockManagementApp](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/1149019373): Full-stack stock management application.
- [duel_master](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/1020425980): Backend service for the Duel Masters card game.
- [My3DChess](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/739760490): 3D chess built with the Unity engine.
- [editor](https://T-Fluffy.github.io/tarek-portfolio/#/project/999870584): Online document editor platform web app.
